column2: The best is saved for last.
Live and let live.
A strict teacher produces outstanding students.
A slow remedy cannot resolve an emergency.
It is impolite not to reciprocate.
When it rains, it pours.
It's better to rely on yourself than on the help of others.
Effort pays off.
At the beginning of the New Year, everything takes on a new look.
You can’t make bricks without straw.

column1: 學如逆水行舟，不進則退
column2: Learning is like rowing upstream: if you stop, you drift back.
Only at perilous times will one's integrity be tested and manifested.
One cannot know what will happen tomorrow.
The landscapes of Guilin are the finest in the world.
It's harder to be cold and detached when you look someone in the eyes.
One cannot judge someone by his or her appearance.
Don't believe what people tell you until you see it for yourself.
Different trades are worlds apart.
Do not fail to carry out an act of kindness just because it is small in scale.
One who errs unknowingly need not be held responsible.

column1: 金窩銀窩，不如自己的狗窩
column2: There's no place like home.
It's the thought that counts.
Worry about seeking the proper path, do not worry about being poor.
We'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
Things become more difficult when we approach closer to success.
One careless move and the whole game is lost.
Dignity is important to people.
Easier said than done.
A gentleman settles a dispute through communication instead of a fight.
A timely snow augurs a year of good harvest.
One must value each grain of rice and not waste it.
Someone will always step forward if they think they will be rewarded.
Those who have the same misfortune sympathize with each other.
One should reflect on oneself first whenever there are conflicts.
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
It is better to solve the root problem, rather than treating the symptoms.
There is always a way out.
Managing a family is not easy, and requires responsibility.
Lookers-on see most of the game.
Haste makes waste.
Unity is strength.
One may know a person from the outside but may not understand their true nature.
There's no turning back after you make an important decision.
Just do good deeds and do not worry about the future.
One must personally experience something in order to know what it's like.
Seeing is believing.
Previous experience of failure can serve as a lesson for oneself or others.
Agreement is difficult if there are too many people.

column1: 養兒一百歲，長憂九十九
column2: A parent always cares about their children no matter how old they are.
Preparedness ensures success and unpreparedness spells failure.
Birds of a feather flock together.
Do not commit an evil act just because it is small in scale.
A small mistake can lead to a massive disaster.
Still waters run deep.
Many hands make light work.
Little strokes fell great oaks.

column1: 揀啊揀，揀著一個賣龍眼
column2: Be too choosy and you'll choose the worst.
No pain, no gain.
It's better to move ahead slowly than just to mark time.

column1: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩
column2: Once bitten, twice shy.
Heaven helps those who help themselves.
Everybody has something that they were born to be good at.
If you do not hold the post, do not meddle in the affairs of that post.
Time flies like an arrow.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Don't forget past events as they can guide you in the future.
Heaven never bars one's way.
With justice on your side, you can go anywhere.
A virtuous person is never solitary but always has companions.

column1: 三百六十行，行行出狀元
column2: One can become successful with accomplishment in any industry or profession.
When you make it a habit, it will become second nature.
Heroes come from the youth.
Whether a nation stands or falls depends on ordinary citizens.
It's dark right under the lamp.
If people have no faith in a person, there is no standing for that person.
Turn big problems into small ones, and small ones into no problems at all.
Nothing can be accomplished with one single effort.
It's never too late.
Above, there is heaven, below, there is Suzhou and Hangzhou.
Times have changed.
The student has surpassed his or her teacher.
Small discrepancies lead to great errors.
An insignificant cause can have a massive effect.
A poor performer overvalues their stationery.
If you make things easy for others, others will make things easy for you.
One gets out what one puts in.
Treasure those who had been good to you when you were in need.
Friends are often made after a fight.
People who do good deeds will have good fortune in the future.

column1: 少壯不努力，老大徒傷悲
column2: Laziness in youth spells regret in old age.
A gentleman must keep his promises.
Do not blindly believe everything written in books.
The more one says, the easier it is to make a mistake.
Each has his or her own task, and there is nobody to spare.
The heavens are looking when humans act.
A young person is often fearless and willing to take risks.
Different people have different views.
One can't know about something unless one experiences it.
There is no flowing without damming and no motion without rest.
If things are shared equally, feelings of affection will never diminish.
One must be educated and endure trials to succeed.
One should be prepared for unexpected situations.
Some are more fortunate than others.
It is important to have good and friendly neighbors.
You get what you pay for.
There is no concealing the truth.
One can become a good person by being in a good environment.
Speech is silver, silence is golden.
Great teachers make great students.

column1: 病來如山倒，病去如抽絲
column2: Illness strikes like a landslide, recovery is as slow as reeling silk.
When the mind is still, you will be calm, cool and collected.

column1: 臨淵羨魚，不如退而結網
column2: One should take practical steps to achieve one's aim.
You must first properly define an issue in order to talk about it intelligently.
Attack the problem at its core.
With a little forbearance, you will find calm and peace.
That which is long divided must unify.
Three for tea, four for wine, and two for a journey.
One does not need to worry about rumours if one is upright.
Joy puts heart into a man.
In carrying out the rules of propriety, ease of manner is to be prized.
There are all kinds of people in a large community.
Opportunity seldom knocks twice, misfortunes never come alone.
Suspicions create imaginary fears.

column1: 好事不出門，壞事傳千里
column2: Good news goes on crutches, but bad news travels fast.
Better safe than sorry.
Do not neglect old friends.
A man without honesty is capable of nothing.
Great minds think alike.

column1: 燒瓷的食缺，織蓆的睏椅
column2: One often neglects those closest to oneself.
Remember where one's happiness comes from.
Someone else's heart is difficult to know.
A friend in need is a friend indeed.

column1: 聽君一席話，勝讀十年書
column2: Listening to the words of a wise person is superior to ten years of studying.

column1: 春天後母面，欲變一時間
column2: Weather in the spring is unpredictable.
Don't put off until tomorrow what can be done today.
One should do good deeds to leave behind a good reputation after one's death.
Even upright officials find it hard to settle family quarrels.
Rumors stop with the wise.
A letter from home is worth ten thousand pieces of gold.

column1: 工欲善其事，必先利其器
column2: One must have good tools in order to do a good job.
It takes two to tango.
A conceited person receives failure, whereas a modest person receives benefits.

column1: 一人苦一項，無人苦相共
column2: Everyone has their own troubles.
The more the truth is debated, the clearer the truth becomes.
An individual with ability will eventually be discovered.

column1: 一寸光陰一寸金，寸金難買寸光陰
column2: Time is priceless.

column1: 一年之計在於春，一日之計在於晨
column2: Early planning is the key to success.
Different places have different customs.
Where there's a will, there's a way.
No matter how bad something is, there is still some value in it.
Everyone has their weak points as well as their strong ones.
A smart person does not dwell on past actions.
Out with the old, in with the new.
A gentleman acts in a principled manner even in the darkest of times.
Something done grudgingly will not produce satisfactory results.
A virtuous man makes his fortune in a proper way.

column1: 烏雲遮不住太陽的光輝
column2: The dark clouds cannot cover the glory of the sun.
Peace and safety is the root of happiness.
Having a sense of shame is a form of bravery.
Prosperity and decline never last.
People are a reflection of their environment.
A wise man does not fight when the odds are against him.
People won't understand you unless you explain things clearly.

column1: 寧欺白鬚公，莫欺少年窮
column2: Do not look down on a young person for being poor.
Too many cooks spoil the broth.
If everyone had accurate foresight, nobody would fail.
Only through diligent practice can one become proficient in the skill or art.
Nobody will find fault with extra courtesy.
Everybody thinks and acts a little differently.
A guest should never try to put himself in a superior position to his host.
If a friend asks for a favor, you should do your utmost to help.

column1: 路遙知馬力，日久見人心
column2: Distance tests a horse’s strength; time reveals a person’s heart.
A gentleman's word is as good as gold.
When people are united in their determination, they can work miracles.
Seize the day.
One generation plants trees, the next enjoys their shade.
Actions speak louder than words.
When two parties fight, it is always the third one who wins.

column1: 冤冤相報何時了，得饒人處且饒人
column2: Vengeance begets vengeance, so it is often better to forgive.
It is best to forgive and forget.
Getting started is always the hardest part.
There is always someone that one can learn from among a group of people.
If you compare your lot to others, you will only torture yourself.

column1: 留得青山在，不怕沒柴燒
column2: While there's life, there's hope.
No secret can be kept forever.
When the conversation is not congenial, to say even half a sentence is too much.
Do not be greedy or you will suffer losses.
A talented person is free to choose his own boss.

column1: 臺上一分鐘，臺下十年功
column2: A minute on stage takes ten years of work offstage.
Nobody is perfect.
A true hero does not boast about their past glories.
One should not hesitate when doing something painful but necessary.
Making full preparation will not delay your job but quicken the process.
Cleverness may overreach itself.

column1: 三分天註定，七分靠拍拚
column2: Only through hard work and perseverance can one achieve success.
It is easier to climb up a mountain than to go down a mountain.
No matter how much something changes, it will still retain its essence.
There's no smoke without fire.
Failure is the mother of success.
Silence is golden.

column1: 阿婆不嫁女，哪得孫兒抱
column2: How can one expect to gain anything if one is unwilling to make sacrifices?

column1: 三個臭皮匠，勝過諸葛亮
column2: Two heads are better than one.
That which one thinks about during the day, is what one dreams about at night.
With earnestness and sincerity everything is achievable.
Patient work makes fine things.
Even with your own brothers, keep clear accounts.
Confrontation of politicians causes suffering to ordinary people.

column1: 年到二十七，過年差三日
column2: Waiting for Chinese New Year, everyone is eager.
The more friends one has, the more options one has in life.
Opportunity seldom knocks twice.
Advice from others may help remedy one's own shortcomings.
Even smart people can have a momentary lapse in judgement.

column1: 酒逢知己千杯少，話不投機半句多
column2: If you drink with a bosom friend, a thousand cups are too few.
The best part of the day is the early morning.
As you sow, so shall you reap.
Heaven does not abide by the wishes of people.
Harmony in the family leads to prosperity in all undertakings.
It's lonely at the top.
Look before you leap.
